note: Camas County (and Fairfield, its seat) publish zoning only as PDF maps and ordinance text (2020 zoning map PDF, 2023 ordinance). Searches of ArcGIS Online/Hub and the county and Fairfield open-data and GIS pages found no queryable zoning district polygon service. The county's GIS property page (gismaps.org) is a directory with no public zoning layer.
